landing.heroSub: Private. Safe. Free. No login required.
landing.trustBar: No name. No phone number. No account. Ever.
landing.breastCancerDesc: A short, gentle questionnaire to understand your risk factors.
landing.pcosDesc: Check symptoms related to periods, weight and hormones.
landing.menopauseDesc: Understand what stage you may be in and what to expect.

assistant.name: Kathaipoma AI
assistant.greeting: Hello, I'm Kathaipoma AI. I'm here to explain every question in simple words. You can also listen instead of reading.

consent.title: Before we begin
consent.point2: We never ask your phone number.
consent.point3: We never store your personal identity.
consent.note: Your anonymous answers may be used only to improve Kathaipoma AI.
consent.checkbox: I understand and I agree to continue anonymously.

emergency.body: Based on some of your answers, please speak with a qualified doctor as soon as possible.
emergency.disclaimer: This application cannot diagnose diseases. It only raises awareness.

results.title: Your results
results.seeDoctor: Please consult a qualified doctor for a proper diagnosis.
results.disclaimer: Kathaipoma is an awareness and preliminary screening tool, not a medical diagnosis.

about.title: About & Privacy
about.body1: Kathaipoma is an anonymous women's health awareness and preliminary screening companion. It is not a hospital, and it does not diagnose disease.
about.body2: No login, no account, no password. We do not collect your name, phone number, or identity. Anonymous answers may be used only to improve Kathaipoma AI.
about.body3: No tracking cookies, no advertisements, no selling of data.
